title: 15 second vertical comedy clip, 9:16, photorealistic, shot like a real phone…
content:
15 second vertical comedy clip, 9:16, photorealistic, shot like a real phone video that turns into a fast fashion montage. Cut driven, handheld, no music.

MAYA. 27, olive skin, long chestnut brown wavy hair with sun lightened strands, dark brown eyes, gold hoops, layered gold necklaces, thin bracelets. Wears a fitted ivory sleeveless square neck top, high waisted colorful print resort trousers, thin tan belt, barefoot. Very expressive face.

LENA. 28, tall, golden skin, long dark espresso brown glossy waves, hazel brown eyes, gold earrings, calm and confident. Same face, same hair, same body, same age in every shot. Only her clothes change.

SETTING: a white motor yacht anchored in a calm turquoise Mediterranean bay. White sailboats in the distance, low rocky green coastline on the same side the whole time, cloudless blue sky, bright late morning sun from the same direction in every shot. White deck, steel railings, cream cushions, coiled ropes. Light sea breeze moves hair and fabric.

STYLE: natural sunlight, real skin texture with pores, correct hands and fingers, real fabric movement, clear turquoise water, no beauty filter, no plastic skin, no heavy HDR.

CAMERA: handheld with small natural shake. Fast whip pans and hard match cuts between outfits. Normal lens, no slow motion, no floating drone moves, no heavy blur.

0.0 to 1.6s Maya stands on the deck, medium close up, sea behind her. She stares off to the right, eyebrows up, mouth open, and leans forward. Maya says, flat and shocked: {No. Absolutely not.} Do not show what she is looking at. <water lapping, hull creak, distant seabirds, wind>

1.6 to 3.0s Camera pushes in. Maya covers her mouth, then drops her hand and points hard to the right. Maya says: {You said ONE outfit!} On the word "outfit" the camera whip pans right along her arm. <bracelets clink, quick footsteps, fast whoosh>

3.0 to 4.6s The pan lands on Lena at the bow, wearing an oversized open white linen shirt over a black one piece swimsuit, black sunglasses, flat sandals, big woven tote. Beside her sit one large suitcase, a garment bag and two tote bags. Medium full shot, railing leading toward her. Lena says calmly: {It is one outfit.} Small pause, she lifts one finger: {For now.} <breeze, rope creak>

4.6 to 6.0s Hard match cut, same body position. Lena now wears a cobalt blue swimsuit with a white sheer sarong tied at her waist, hair damp at the temples, barefoot. She takes two steps toward camera and points at the water. Lena says: {Swim.} <bare feet on deck, water splash, fabric flutter>

6.0 to 7.4s A white towel sweeps past the lens, and behind it Lena now sits at a small deck table with fruit and sparkling water, wearing a coral orange halter dress, sunglasses on her head, woven handbag. She lifts the sunglasses slightly and smiles. Lena says: {Lunch.} <chair scrape, glass on table, soft breeze>

7.4 to 8.8s Hard match cut. Lena stands at the railing in an emerald green satin slip dress with gold statement earrings, same daylight. Wind lifts her hair, she turns her head toward Maya. Lena says: {Sunset.} <wind gust, satin flutter>

8.8 to 10.3s Fast whip pan across the cabin. Lena walks past camera in an ivory cropped blazer, matching wide leg trousers, champagne silk camisole, gold heels, small metallic clutch. Camera tracks back one second. Lena says: {Dinner.} <heels clicking, clutch clasp>

10.3 to 11.8s Hard match cut. Medium close up of Lena in a silver metallic evening mini dress with crystal earrings. She adjusts one earring, completely serious. Lena says: {Emergency.} <soft wind, water>

11.8 to 13.2s Smash cut to a tight close up of Maya, honestly confused, looking toward Lena. Maya asks: {What emergency?} <water lapping, distant boat>

13.2 to 15.0s Cut back to Lena, medium shot, silver dress catching the sun, turquoise water, sailboats and green coast behind her. She slides her sunglasses on, gives a tiny smile to camera. Lena says: {Bad photos.} Maya laughs loudly off screen. Lena walks out of frame. Hard end, no fade. <sunglasses click, real laugh, water, one seabird>

AUDIO: only real sound, meaning ocean, wind, boat movement, footsteps, fabric, bracelets, glass, laughter. Dialogue language: English, natural conversational delivery, never theatrical, never both women talking at once. No music at any point. No narration. No subtitles.

Last frame: empty yacht deck at the bow, turquoise bay, sailboats and green coastline behind, bright sunlight, gentle water movement. No on screen text, no captions, no logo, no watermark.

Negative prompt: music, score, subtitles, on screen text, watermarks, logos, brand names, extra people, two Lenas, two Mayas, changing face, changing hair, changing age, mixed or merged outfits, clothes morphing on the body without a cut, magical transformation, slow motion, drone shots, warped hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, beauty filter, oversaturated colors, moving coastline, changing sun direction, horizontal framing.

es.content:
---
Clip cómico vertical de 15 segundos, 9:16, fotorrealista, filmado como un video real de teléfono que se convierte en un montaje de fast fashion. Edición rápida, cámara en mano, sin música.

MAYA. 27, piel oliva, cabello largo ondulado castaño con mechones aclarados por el sol, ojos marrón oscuro, aros dorados, collares dorados en capas, pulseras finas. Lleva un top entallado marfil sin mangas con escote cuadrado, pantalones de resort de tiro alto con estampado colorido, cinturón fino color tostado, descalza. Rostro muy expresivo.

LENA. 28, alta, piel dorada, largas ondas brillantes color espresso oscuro, ojos avellana marrones, pendientes dorados, tranquila y segura. La misma cara, el mismo cabello, el mismo cuerpo, la misma edad en cada plano. Solo cambia su ropa.

ESCENARIO: un yate a motor blanco anclado en una tranquila bahía mediterránea turquesa. Veleros blancos a lo lejos, costa rocosa baja y verde en el mismo lado todo el tiempo, cielo azul sin nubes, sol brillante de última hora de la mañana desde la misma dirección en cada plano. Cubierta blanca, barandillas de acero, cojines color crema, cuerdas enrolladas. La brisa marina ligera mueve el cabello y la tela.

ESTILO: luz solar natural, textura real de la piel con poros, manos y dedos correctos, movimiento real de las telas, agua turquesa clara, sin filtro de belleza, sin piel plástica, sin HDR exagerado.

CÁMARA: cámara en mano con un pequeño temblor natural. Whip pans rápidos y hard match cuts entre outfits. Lente normal, sin cámara lenta, sin movimientos flotantes de dron, sin desenfoque fuerte.

0.0 a 1.6s Maya está de pie en la cubierta, plano medio corto, el mar detrás de ella. Mira hacia la derecha, con las cejas levantadas y la boca abierta, y se inclina hacia delante. Maya dice, seca y en shock: {No. Absolutely not.} No mostrar lo que está mirando. <chapoteo del agua, crujido del casco, gaviotas lejanas, viento>

1.6 a 3.0s La cámara se acerca. Maya se tapa la boca, luego baja la mano y señala con fuerza hacia la derecha. Maya dice: {You said ONE outfit!} En la palabra "outfit" la cámara hace un whip pan hacia la derecha siguiendo su brazo. <chasquido de pulseras, pasos rápidos, whoosh veloz>

3.0 a 4.6s El paneo aterriza en Lena en la proa, llevando una camisa blanca de lino oversize abierta sobre un bañador negro de una pieza, gafas de sol negras, sandalias planas, gran bolso de mimbre. A su lado hay una maleta grande, una funda para ropa y dos bolsas tote. Plano medio largo, la barandilla conduce hacia ella. Lena dice con calma: {It is one outfit.} Pequeña pausa, levanta un dedo: {For now.} <brisa, crujido de cuerda>

4.6 a 6.0s Hard match cut, misma posición corporal. Lena ahora lleva un bañador azul cobalto con un pareo blanco translúcido anudado a la cintura, el cabello húmedo en las sienes, descalza. Da dos pasos hacia la cámara y señala el agua. Lena dice: {Swim.} <pies descalzos sobre la cubierta, salpicadura de agua, aleteo de tela>

6.0 a 7.4s Una toalla blanca pasa por delante del lente, y detrás Lena ahora está sentada en una pequeña mesa de cubierta con fruta y agua con gas, llevando un vestido halter coral naranja, gafas de sol sobre la cabeza, bolso tejido. Levanta ligeramente las gafas de sol y sonríe. Lena dice: {Lunch.} <arrastre de silla, vaso sobre la mesa, brisa suave>

7.4 a 8.8s Hard match cut. Lena está de pie junto a la barandilla con un vestido lencero de satén verde esmeralda y pendientes dorados llamativos, misma luz de día. El viento le levanta el cabello, gira la cabeza hacia Maya. Lena dice: {Sunset.} <ráfaga de viento, satén ondeando>

8.8 a 10.3s Whip pan rápido a través de la cabina. Lena pasa junto a la cámara con un blazer corto marfil, pantalones anchos a juego, camisola de seda color champán, tacones dorados, pequeño clutch metálico. La cámara retrocede un segundo. Lena dice: {Dinner.} <tacones haciendo clic, cierre del clutch>

10.3 a 11.8s Hard match cut. Plano medio corto de Lena con un minivestido de noche metálico plateado y pendientes de cristal. Se ajusta un pendiente, completamente seria. Lena dice: {Emergency.} <viento suave, agua>

11.8 a 13.2s Smash cut a un primerísimo primer plano de Maya, sinceramente confundida, mirando hacia Lena. Maya pregunta: {What emergency?} <chapoteo del agua, barco lejano>

13.2 a 15.0s Corte de vuelta a Lena, plano medio, el vestido plateado captando el sol, agua turquesa, veleros y costa verde detrás de ella. Se pone las gafas de sol, esboza una pequeña sonrisa a cámara. Lena dice: {Bad photos.} Maya se ríe fuerte fuera de cámara. Lena sale del encuadre. Final brusco, sin fundido. <clic de las gafas de sol, risa real, agua, una gaviota>

AUDIO: solo sonido real, es decir océano, viento, movimiento del barco, pasos, tela, pulseras, cristal, risas. Idioma del diálogo: inglés, interpretación natural y conversacional, nunca teatral, nunca hablan ambas mujeres al mismo tiempo. Sin música en ningún momento. Sin narración. Sin subtítulos.

Último fotograma: cubierta vacía del yate en la proa, bahía turquesa, veleros y costa verde detrás, luz solar brillante, movimiento suave del agua. Sin texto en pantalla, sin captions, sin logo, sin marca de agua.

Negative prompt: music, score, subtitles, on screen text, watermarks, logos, brand names, extra people, two Lenas, two Mayas, changing face, changing hair, changing age, mixed or merged outfits, clothes morphing on the body without a cut, magical transformation, slow motion, drone shots, warped hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, beauty filter, oversaturated colors, moving coastline, changing sun direction, horizontal framing.

fr.content:
---
Clip comique vertical de 15 secondes, 9:16, photoréaliste, filmé comme une vraie vidéo de téléphone qui se transforme en montage de fast fashion. Montage rythmé par les cuts, caméra à main levée, sans musique.

MAYA. 27 ans, peau olive, longs cheveux ondulés châtain brun avec des mèches éclaircies par le soleil, yeux brun foncé, créoles dorées, colliers dorés superposés, bracelets fins. Porte un top ajusté ivoire sans manches à encolure carrée, un pantalon de resort coloré taille haute à imprimé, une fine ceinture beige, pieds nus. Visage très expressif.

LENA. 28 ans, grande, peau dorée, longues ondulations brillantes brun espresso foncé, yeux noisette, boucles d’oreilles dorées, calme et confiante. Même visage, mêmes cheveux, même corps, même âge dans chaque plan. Seuls ses vêtements changent.

DÉCOR : un yacht à moteur blanc ancré dans une baie méditerranéenne turquoise et calme. Voiliers blancs au loin, côte rocheuse basse et verdoyante du même côté tout du long, ciel bleu sans nuages, soleil éclatant de fin de matinée venant de la même direction dans chaque plan. Pont blanc, garde-corps en acier, coussins crème, cordages enroulés. Une légère brise marine fait bouger les cheveux et les tissus.

STYLE : lumière naturelle, vraie texture de peau avec pores, mains et doigts corrects, mouvement réaliste des tissus, eau turquoise nette, pas de filtre beauté, pas de peau plastique, pas de HDR excessif.

CAMÉRA : caméra à main levée avec un léger tremblement naturel. Whip pans rapides et hard match cuts entre les tenues. Objectif normal, pas de ralenti, pas de mouvements de drone flottants, pas de flou prononcé.

0.0 à 1.6s Maya se tient sur le pont, plan moyen rapproché, la mer derrière elle. Elle fixe quelque chose hors champ à droite, sourcils levés, bouche ouverte, et se penche en avant. Maya dit, d’un ton plat et choqué : {No. Absolutely not.} Ne montrez pas ce qu’elle regarde. <clapotis de l’eau, craquement de la coque, oiseaux marins au loin, vent>

1.6 à 3.0s La caméra s’avance. Maya se couvre la bouche, puis baisse la main et pointe vivement vers la droite. Maya dit : {You said ONE outfit!} Sur le mot "outfit", la caméra fait un whip pan vers la droite le long de son bras. <bracelets qui s’entrechoquent, pas rapides, whoosh rapide>

3.0 à 4.6s Le pan se pose sur Lena à la proue, portant une chemise blanche en lin oversize ouverte sur un maillot une pièce noir, des lunettes de soleil noires, des sandales plates, un grand cabas tressé. À côté d’elle se trouvent une grande valise, une housse à vêtements et deux sacs cabas. Plan moyen en pied, la rambarde mène vers elle. Lena dit calmement : {It is one outfit.} Petite pause, elle lève un doigt : {For now.} <brise, grincement de corde>

4.6 à 6.0s Hard match cut, même position du corps. Lena porte maintenant un maillot de bain bleu cobalt avec un paréo blanc transparent noué à la taille, cheveux humides aux tempes, pieds nus. Elle fait deux pas vers la caméra et pointe l’eau. Lena dit : {Swim.} <pieds nus sur le pont, éclaboussure, tissu qui flotte>

6.0 à 7.4s Une serviette blanche balaie l’objectif, et derrière elle Lena est maintenant assise à une petite table de pont avec des fruits et de l’eau pétillante, portant une robe halter orange corail, des lunettes de soleil sur la tête, un sac à main tressé. Elle relève légèrement ses lunettes et sourit. Lena dit : {Lunch.} <grincement de chaise, verre sur la table, brise légère>

7.4 à 8.8s Hard match cut. Lena se tient à la rambarde dans une robe nuisette satinée vert émeraude avec de grandes boucles d’oreilles dorées, même lumière du jour. Le vent soulève ses cheveux, elle tourne la tête vers Maya. Lena dit : {Sunset.} <rafale de vent, satin qui flotte>

8.8 à 10.3s Whip pan rapide à travers la cabine. Lena passe devant la caméra en blazer court ivoire, pantalon large assorti, caraco en soie champagne, talons dorés, petite pochette métallique. La caméra revient en arrière pendant une seconde. Lena dit : {Dinner.} <talons qui claquent, fermoir de la pochette>

10.3 à 11.8s Hard match cut. Plan moyen rapproché de Lena dans une mini-robe de soirée métallique argentée avec des boucles d’oreilles en cristal. Elle ajuste une boucle d’oreille, totalement sérieuse. Lena dit : {Emergency.} <vent léger, eau>

11.8 à 13.2s Smash cut vers un gros plan serré de Maya, sincèrement confuse, regardant Lena. Maya demande : {What emergency?} <clapotis de l’eau, bateau au loin>

13.2 à 15.0s Retour sur Lena, plan moyen, la robe argentée captant le soleil, eau turquoise, voiliers et côte verte derrière elle. Elle remet ses lunettes de soleil, adresse un petit sourire à la caméra. Lena dit : {Bad photos.} Maya rit bruyamment hors champ. Lena sort du cadre. Fin nette, sans fondu. <clic des lunettes, vrai rire, eau, un oiseau marin>

AUDIO : uniquement des sons réels, donc l’océan, le vent, les mouvements du bateau, les pas, les tissus, les bracelets, le verre, les rires. Langue des dialogues : anglais, interprétation naturelle et conversationnelle, jamais théâtrale, jamais les deux femmes parlant en même temps. Aucune musique à aucun moment. Aucune narration. Aucun sous-titre.

Dernier plan : pont vide du yacht à la proue, baie turquoise, voiliers et côte verdoyante derrière, lumière vive, léger mouvement de l’eau. Aucun texte à l’écran, aucune légende, aucun logo, aucun filigrane.

LENA. 28歳、背が高く、ゴールド寄りの肌、長いダークエスプレッソブラウンの艶やかなウェーブヘア、ヘーゼルブラウンの瞳、ゴールドのイヤリング、落ち着いていて自信がある。すべてのショットで同じ顔、同じ髪、同じ体、同じ年齢。変わるのは服だけ。

SETTING: 穏やかなターコイズブルーの地中海の入り江に停泊した白いモーターヨット。遠くに白い帆船、ずっと同じ側に見える低い岩場の緑の海岸線、雲ひとつない青空、すべてのショットで同じ方向から差す明るい午前遅めの太陽。白いデッキ、スチールの手すり、クリーム色のクッション、巻かれたロープ。弱い海風が髪と布を揺らす。

ko.content:
15초 세로형 코미디 클립, 9:16, 포토리얼리스틱, 실제 휴대폰 영상처럼 촬영되다가 빠른 패션 몽타주로 전환됨. 컷 중심, 핸드헬드, 음악 없음.

MAYA. 27세, 올리브 톤 피부, 햇빛에 밝아진 가닥이 섞인 긴 밤색 웨이브 머리, 짙은 갈색 눈, 골드 후프 귀걸이, 레이어드 골드 목걸이, 얇은 팔찌. 몸에 딱 맞는 아이보리색 민소매 스퀘어넥 탑, 하이웨이스트 컬러 프린트 리조트 팬츠, 얇은 탄색 벨트, 맨발 착용. 표정이 매우 풍부함.

LENA. 28세, 키가 크고, 골든 스킨, 길고 짙은 에스프레소 브라운의 윤기 나는 웨이브 머리, 헤이즐 브라운 눈, 골드 귀걸이, 차분하고 자신감 있음. 모든 샷에서 같은 얼굴, 같은 머리, 같은 몸, 같은 나이. 옷만 바뀜.

SETTING: 잔잔한 터키색 지중해 만에 정박한 흰색 모터 요트. 멀리 흰색 세일보트, 내내 같은 쪽에 보이는 낮고 바위가 많은 초록빛 해안선, 구름 한 점 없는 파란 하늘, 모든 샷에서 같은 방향에서 들어오는 밝은 늦은 아침 햇살. 흰색 데크, 스틸 난간, 크림색 쿠션, 감겨 있는 로프. 가벼운 바닷바람이 머리카락과 천을 움직임.

STYLE: 자연광, 모공이 보이는 실제 피부 질감, 정확한 손과 손가락, 실제 천의 움직임, 선명한 터키색 물, 뷰티 필터 없음, 플라스틱 같은 피부 없음, 과한 HDR 없음.

CAMERA: 작은 자연스러운 흔들림이 있는 핸드헬드. 의상 사이를 빠르게 잇는 휩 팬과 하드 매치 컷. 일반 렌즈, 슬로모션 없음, 떠다니는 드론 무브 없음, 과한 블러 없음.

1.6 to 3.0s Camera pushes in. Maya covers her mouth, then drops her hand and points hard to the right. Maya says: {You said ONE outfit!} On the word "outfit" the camera whip pans right along her arm. <bracelets clink, quick footsteps, fast whoosh>

3.0 to 4.6s The pan lands on Lena at the bow, wearing an oversized open white linen shirt over a black one piece swimsuit, black sunglasses, flat sandals, big woven tote. Beside her sit one large suitcase, a garment bag and two tote bags. Medium full shot, railing leading toward her. Lena says calmly: {It is one outfit.} Small pause, she lifts one finger: {For now.} <breeze, rope creak>

4.6 to 6.0s Hard match cut, same body position. Lena now wears a cobalt blue swimsuit with a white sheer sarong tied at her waist, hair damp at the temples, barefoot. She takes two steps toward camera and points at the water. Lena says: {Swim.} <bare feet on deck, water splash, fabric flutter>

6.0 to 7.4s A white towel sweeps past the lens, and behind it Lena now sits at a small deck table with fruit and sparkling water, wearing a coral orange halter dress, sunglasses on her head, woven handbag. She lifts the sunglasses slightly and smiles. Lena says: {Lunch.} <chair scrape, glass on table, soft breeze>

7.4 to 8.8s Hard match cut. Lena stands at the railing in an emerald green satin slip dress with gold statement earrings, same daylight. Wind lifts her hair, she turns her head toward Maya. Lena says: {Sunset.} <wind gust, satin flutter>

8.8 to 10.3s Fast whip pan across the cabin. Lena walks past camera in an ivory cropped blazer, matching wide leg trousers, champagne silk camisole, gold heels, small metallic clutch. Camera tracks back one second. Lena says: {Dinner.} <heels clicking, clutch clasp>

10.3 to 11.8s Hard match cut. Medium close up of Lena in a silver metallic evening mini dress with crystal earrings. She adjusts one earring, completely serious. Lena says: {Emergency.} <soft wind, water>

11.8 to 13.2s Smash cut to a tight close up of Maya, honestly confused, looking toward Lena. Maya asks: {What emergency?} <water lapping, distant boat>

13.2 to 15.0s Cut back to Lena, medium shot, silver dress catching the sun, turquoise water, sailboats and green coast behind her. She slides her sunglasses on, gives a tiny smile to camera. Lena says: {Bad photos.} Maya laughs loudly off screen. Lena walks out of frame. Hard end, no fade. <sunglasses click, real laugh, water, one seabird>

AUDIO: only real sound, meaning ocean, wind, boat movement, footsteps, fabric, bracelets, glass, laughter. Dialogue language: English, natural conversational delivery, never theatrical, never both women talking at once. No music at any point. No narration. No subtitles.

Last frame: empty yacht deck at the bow, turquoise bay, sailboats and green coastline behind, bright sunlight, gentle water movement. No on screen text, no captions, no logo, no watermark.

15 second vertical comedy clip, 9:16, photorealistic, shot like a real phone video that turns into a fast fashion montage. Cut driven, handheld, no music.

MAYA. 27, pele oliva, cabelo longo castanho-avelã ondulado com mechas clareadas pelo sol, olhos castanho-escuros, argolas douradas, colares dourados em camadas, pulseiras finas. Usa um top justo sem mangas, gola quadrada, marfim, calça resort estampada colorida de cintura alta, cinto fino bege, descalça. Rosto muito expressivo.

LENA. 28, alta, pele dourada, ondas longas e brilhantes em castanho espresso escuro, olhos castanho-avelã, brincos dourados, calma e confiante. Mesmo rosto, mesmo cabelo, mesmo corpo, mesma idade em cada plano. Só as roupas mudam.

SETTING: um iate a motor branco ancorado em uma baía mediterrânea calma e turquesa. Veleiros brancos ao longe, costa baixa rochosa e verde no mesmo lado o tempo todo, céu azul sem nuvens, sol forte de fim de manhã vindo da mesma direção em cada plano. Convés branco, corrimãos de aço, almofadas creme, cordas enroladas. Brisa leve do mar move cabelo e tecido.

zh.content:
15秒竖屏喜剧短片，9:16，写实风格，像一段真实手机视频，随后切换成快时尚蒙太奇。以剪辑驱动，手持拍摄，无音乐。

MAYA。27岁，橄榄色皮肤，长长的栗棕色波浪卷发，带有被阳光染浅的发丝，深棕色眼睛，金色圆环耳环，叠戴金项链，细手链。穿一件修身象牙白无袖方领上衣、高腰彩色印花度假长裤、细棕色腰带，赤脚。表情非常丰富。

LENA。28岁，高个子，金色肤色，长长的深浓缩咖啡棕色亮泽波浪卷发，榛棕色眼睛，金色耳环，冷静而自信。每一镜里都保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一身体、同一年龄。只有她的衣服会变。

场景：一艘白色机动游艇，停泊在平静的碧绿地中海海湾。远处有白色帆船，低矮多岩、绿色的海岸线始终在同一侧，万里无云的蓝天，明亮的上午晚些时候阳光始终从同一方向照射。白色甲板、钢制栏杆、米色坐垫、盘绕的绳索。轻柔海风吹动头发和布料。

风格：自然阳光，真实皮肤纹理与毛孔，手和手指正确，布料真实摆动，清澈的碧绿海水，无美颜滤镜，无塑料感皮肤，无强烈 HDR。

摄影机：手持，带轻微自然抖动。快速甩镜和硬切匹配剪辑在不同服装之间切换。普通镜头，无慢动作，无漂浮式无人机运动，无强烈模糊。

0.0 到 1.6 秒 Maya 站在甲板上，中近景，身后是大海。她朝右边盯着看，眉毛上挑，嘴巴张开，身体前倾。Maya 语气平淡但震惊地说：{不。绝对不行。} 不要展示她在看什么。 <水拍打船身，船体吱呀声，远处海鸟，风声>

1.6 到 3.0 秒 摄影机向前推进。Maya 捂住嘴，然后放下手，狠狠指向右边。Maya 说：{你说的是一套衣服！} 在“衣服”这个词上，摄影机沿着她的手臂向右快速甩镜。 <手链碰撞声，快速脚步声，迅速掠过的呼啸声>

3.0 到 4.6 秒 甩镜落到船头的 Lena 身上，她穿着一件宽松敞开的白色亚麻衬衫，里面是黑色连体泳衣，黑色太阳镜，平底凉鞋，大号编织托特包。她旁边放着一个大行李箱、一个衣物袋和两个托特包。中景全身，栏杆线条朝她延伸。Lena 平静地说：{这就是一套衣服。} 短暂停顿后，她竖起一根手指：{暂时。} <微风，绳索吱呀声>

4.6 到 6.0 秒 硬切匹配镜头，身体姿势相同。Lena 现在穿着钴蓝色泳衣，腰间系着白色半透明纱笼，太阳穴处头发微湿，赤脚。她向镜头走两步，并指向海面。Lena 说：{游泳。} <赤脚踩在甲板上，水花声，布料飘动>

6.0 到 7.4 秒 一条白色毛巾从镜头前扫过，毛巾后方 Lena 现在坐在一张摆着水果和气泡水的小甲板桌旁，穿着珊瑚橙色挂脖连衣裙，太阳镜顶在头上，手提编织包。她微微抬起太阳镜，露出微笑。Lena 说：{午餐。} <椅子摩擦声，玻璃杯放在桌上，轻柔海风>

7.4 到 8.8 秒 硬切匹配镜头。Lena 站在栏杆旁，穿着祖母绿缎面吊带裙，戴着金色夸张耳饰，光线仍是同样的日光。风吹起她的头发，她转头看向 Maya。Lena 说：{日落。} <阵风，缎面飘动>

8.8 到 10.3 秒 快速甩镜横扫过船舱。Lena 从镜头前走过，穿着象牙白短款西装外套、同色阔腿裤、香槟色真丝吊带背心、金色高跟鞋，手拿小号金属感手拿包。摄影机向后跟拍一秒。Lena 说：{晚餐。} <高跟鞋敲击声，手拿包扣合声>

10.3 到 11.8 秒 硬切匹配镜头。Lena 的中近景，穿着银色金属感晚宴迷你裙，戴着水晶耳环。她调整了一只耳环，神情极其认真。Lena 说：{紧急情况。} <轻风，海水声>

11.8 到 13.2 秒 直接切到 Maya 的特写，她真诚地困惑着，看向 Lena。Maya 问：{什么紧急情况？} <水拍打声，远处船只声>

13.2 到 15.0 秒 切回 Lena，中景，银色裙子在阳光下闪耀，身后是碧绿海水、帆船和绿色海岸。她戴上太阳镜，对镜头露出一丝微笑。Lena 说：{糟糕的照片。} Maya 在画外大笑。Lena 走出画面。硬切结束，不要淡出。 <太阳镜咔哒声，真实笑声，海水声，一只海鸟>

音频：只保留真实声音，即海洋、风、船体运动、脚步、布料、手链、玻璃、笑声。对白语言：英语，自然口语化表达，绝不戏剧化，且两位女性绝不同时说话。全程无音乐。无旁白。无字幕。

最后一帧：船头空无一人的游艇甲板，碧绿海湾，后方有帆船和绿色海岸线，明亮阳光，海面轻微起伏。无屏幕文字、无说明文字、无 logo、无水印。
